subject.title: [Bug]: Slack Socket Mode ghost connections after gateway restart silently drop inbound messages

question: Should Slack Socket Mode remain warning-only for multiple active connections, or should OpenClaw add plugin-owned recovery/fencing for restart ghost connections after live Slack proof?
rationale: Slack documents multiple active Socket Mode connections as valid, but this issue reports message loss when stale restart ghosts share the same app token; automation cannot choose the compatibility policy or false-positive tolerance.

options.title: Live-proof a recovery path
options.body: Require a real Slack restart reproduction, then implement recovery that targets stale same-gateway ghosts without breaking documented multi-gateway, relay, or HTTP setups.

options.title: Keep warning-only behavior
options.body: Treat the current diagnostic and docs as the supported policy and accept the stop-wait-start operator workaround until stronger evidence justifies automatic intervention.

options.title: Route production scale elsewhere
options.body: Document Socket Mode as single-gateway-first and push multi-gateway reliability to relay mode or HTTP Request URLs instead of adding more Socket Mode policy.

recommendation.title: Live-proof a recovery path
recommendation.body: Require a real Slack restart reproduction, then implement recovery that targets stale same-gateway ghosts without breaking documented multi-gateway, relay, or HTTP setups.
